key_insight: GWDM combines wavelet-based diffusion with histopathology-specific guidance to generate realistic tissue image patches for training-data augmentation.
clinical_relevance: Synthetic patches improved downstream nuclei and tissue segmentation in benchmark experiments, suggesting potential value for research on data-limited pathology AI.
method: Use wavelets to capture image details at multiple scales.
Condition generation on tissue patterns and staining variations.
Gradually introduce histomorphological guidance using perceptual and structural similarity losses.
evidence_signal: Across BCSS, MoNuSeg, and PAIP2019, the abstract reports better synthesis than state-of-the-art methods and segmentation gains when synthetic images augmented real training data.
watch_item: Benchmark improvements do not establish clinical readiness; synthetic-image fidelity and generalization across laboratories require further validation.
paper_title: GWDM: A Guided Wavelet Diffusion Model for Realistic Histopathology Image Generation
